title: Soda and Candy Get Pricier!
story: Buzzyland is buzzing with the news that the price of FIZZ soda and CNDY candy might go up! It's summer, and there's a shortage of the special syrup that makes these treats extra yummy.
storyBig: In Buzzyland, the price of FIZZ soda and CNDY candy is set to rise due to a shortage of a key syrup ingredient during the busy summer season. This supply chain disruption is expected to increase production costs, leading to higher product prices.
think: Why do you think shortages can make prices go up?
bull: Summer might make candy and soda even more popular!
bear: Higher prices might make people buy less candy or soda.

title: Robots: Fun or Too Smart?
story: The head of ROBO, the robot company, says robots are super cool, but some people worry they might become too smart. ROBO wants everyone to know they're working hard to make safe robots for fun and learning.
storyBig: ROBO, a leading company in the robotics industry, assures the public that while their robots are getting smarter, they prioritize safety and user-friendly design. As concerns about over-advanced technology grow, ROBO emphasizes its commitment to responsible innovation.
think: How can robots help us in fun and safe ways?
bull: More people might get excited to learn with robots!
bear: If robots get too smart, some people might get worried.
